voice_provider: Fish Audio REST API (POST https://api.fish.audio/v1/tts), paid, owner-approved
model_note: Fish docs (fetched 2026-11-20): s1 is deprecated and is retired 2026-12-31. After that, s1 requests are served by s2.1-pro, which ignores (parenthesis) tags and uses [bracket] tags. Migrate before 2026-12-31: owner approval + a short continuity test first.
voice_id_source: .env FISH_VOICE_ID (the 'Adam' voice model chosen by the owner). Never printed, never changed without owner approval.
accent: whatever Adam's voice model has; do not try to change it
measured_speed: Measured 2026-11-20 (trimmed speech, no pauses): speed 1.0 = 6.3 w/s, 0.85 = 5.4, 0.75 = 4.9, 0.7 = 4.7, 0.6 = 4.1 (rate ~ 6.26*speed^0.83). Adam is far faster than the kit's 145 WPM (2.4 w/s); pacing comes from speed 0.65-0.85 PLUS (break) at phrase boundaries PLUS pipeline pauses/reaction beats. The old '3.4 w/s' figure included pauses.

supported_controls.temperature: 0-1, default 0.7 (expressiveness); keep the default unless a continuity test approves a change
supported_controls.s1_inline_tags: (emotion) at the START of a sentence, max 3 per sentence. Fish documents these as tags, not spoken text
supported_controls.s1_emotions: happy sad angry excited calm nervous confident surprised satisfied delighted scared worried upset frustrated depressed empathetic embarrassed disgusted moved proud relaxed grateful curious sarcastic disdainful unhappy anxious hysterical indifferent uncertain doubtful confused disappointed regretful guilty ashamed jealous envious hopeful optimistic pessimistic nostalgic lonely bored contemptuous sympathetic compassionate determined resigned
supported_controls.pauses: pipeline gap between lines (line.pause seconds) is exact; (break)/(long-break) inside a line are model-decided lengths
supported_controls.seed: NOT supported (no seed field in the Fish TTS schema)

rendering_policy: One Fish call per script line with identical voice/model/settings (the pipeline needs per-line timings for captions and shots). Every line uses the same reference_id, model, temperature and top_p. Only prosody.speed, prosody.volume, inline s1 tags and the pause after the line vary.
speaker_change_policy: Never change voice_id or model_id between lines, scenes or uploads without owner approval. Character dialogue is performed by Adam with emotion/tone tags, not by other voices, unless the owner approves a second voice.
tag_safety: Tags go only in the line's `say` field, never in captions. After every narration, Whisper must NOT hear any tag word (e.g. 'sad', 'whispering') that is not in the caption text; if it does, that tag is being spoken: remove it and re-render that line.

speed_policy.note: Owner Rule Q (2026-11-21): the 0.65-0.75 pacing of the Lie-Monster episode was too slow. Stay near Adam's natural pace; slow only a little for sad/tender lines.

loudness_policy: Final mix via pipeline/assemble.py loudnorm (I=-13 target, TP -1.5); measured result must be -14 LUFS +-1.5 with no clipping.
approval_policy: Any change to model, voice, temperature or top_p: render the hook + the most emotional line as a test and get owner approval before a full narration.

unsafe_tags.(regretful): spoken aloud in the 2026-11-20 test; use (sad) or (guilty) instead
unsafe_tags.(hopeful): spoken aloud in the 2026-11-20 full narration; use (happy)(soft tone)
unsafe_tags._rule: Advanced emotions leak at random (regretful, hopeful, guilty). Use only the 24 BASIC emotions + tones. The leak gate in pipeline/assemble.py and pipeline/voicecheck.py catches the rest.
unsafe_tags.(guilty): spoken aloud in the 2026-11-20 full narration (passed one earlier test: leaks are random); use (sad)

tested_tags.untested: every other tag: run the Whisper tag-leak check on every narration

pause_policy.silent_visual_beat: only where the screen shows an action/effect; keep it as short as the action

volume_policy.note: prosody.volume in dB per line (Fish). Loudnorm on the final keeps these relative differences.

model_switch_2026_11_24: Owner approved by ear: Adam on s2.1-pro-free ($0, fair-use) via .env FISH_MODEL. Tags: leading (tag) is sent as [tag]. Pace: prosody.speed x1.14 (audio.S2_PACE) to match s1. To go back: FISH_MODEL=s1 (paid, retires 2026-12-31).
